messages.author: Jianguo Li
messages.body: Dear All,I would like to simulate a membrane that consists of sphingomyelin lipid. I am wondering if anyone has parameterized sphingomyelin and share the parameters?Thank you and have a nice day!best regards,JianguoBioinformatics Institue, A*STARSingaproe

messages.author: Gould, Ian R
messages.body:
We will be releasing Lipid 20 very shortly which does have sphingomyelin parameterised. We hope to do this in the next month or so.
